name: Pixi Jasmine Oil Blend 30ml Hydrating Repair Oil with Jasmine Extract and Evening Primrose for All Skin
description:
Revive stressed and dehydrated skin with Pixi Jasmine Oil Blend, a nourishing face oil designed to restore balance and radiance. Infused with jasmine flower extract, evening primrose, and grape seed oil, it deeply hydrates while calming irritation and reducing dullness. Rich in antioxidants and Vitamin C, this lightweight oil helps repair skin damage, support collagen restoration, and promote a healthy, glowing complexion. Suitable for all skin types, paraben-free, and cruelty-free.
Key Features:
Volume: 30ml / 1.01 fl oz
Jasmine Flower Extract for calming balance
Evening Primrose Oil rich in omega-6, boosts hydration
Grape Seed Oil for antioxidant and collagen support
Lightweight formula absorbs quickly
Suitable for all skin types
Paraben-free and cruelty-free
How to Use:
Use morning and evening on cleansed, toned skin
Warm a few drops in hands and press onto skin
Add 2–3 drops to moisturizer for extra hydration
Ingredients:
Jasmine Flower Extract, Evening Primrose Oil, Grape Seed Oil, Vitamin C
Safety Information:
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Store in a cool, dry place

Package Includes:
1 × Pixi Jasmine Oil Blend 30ml
